Entries.Original: Once you are ready, select "Battles" to begin!
In Endless Mode,\nyou will attempt to progress in a continual,\nnever-ending stage for as long as possible.
After you defeat the area boss, you will proceed to the next area.\nThe further you get, the stronger the enemies will become.
In addition, your score in Endless Mode\nwill be recorded in the seasonal Score Board.
Customize your deck and go for top of the rankings!
You can get [Support Capsules] by using Arts Tokens\nto pull from the Token Recruitment.
